Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

Literal pools, `adr` and interworking, checked against GNU as, which is what
the source that uses them was written for; see tools/xas-diff/README.md.
Every snippet starts with `.syntax unified`. GNU as gives ARM code a section
alignment of 4 and pads the end of a code section to a word, and so does
rsasm, so sections need no `.p2align` of their own here.

=== literals loaded from a pool at the end of the section
        .syntax unified
        .text
entry:  ldr     r0, =0x12345678
        ldr     r1, =msg
        ldr     r2, =msg + 3
        ldr     r3, =entry
        ldr     r4, =0x100
        bx      lr
        .data
msg:    .ascii  "hello"

=== a pool placed by ltorg, and a second one after it
        .syntax unified
entry:  ldr     r0, =table
        b       over
        .ltorg
over:   ldr     r1, =table + 4
        ldr     r2, =0xdeadbeef
        bx      lr
        .section .rodata
        .byte   1
table:  .word   1, 2, 3

=== adr and adrl within a section @ 0x10000
        .syntax unified
back:   adr     r0, back
        adr     r1, fwd
        adrl    r2, far
        adrl    r3, back
fwd:    nop
        .space  0x2000
far:    bx      lr

=== pools in two code sections
        .syntax unified
        .text
start:  ldr     r0, =other
        bx      lr
        .section .text.other, "ax"
other:  ldr     r0, =0x11223344
        ldr     r1, =start
        bx      lr

=== calls between ARM and Thumb functions in two sections
        .syntax unified
        .text
        .global start
        .type   start, %function
start:  bl      tfunc
        blx     tfunc
        bl      afunc
        blx     afunc
        bl      local
        bx      lr
        .type   local, %function
local:  bx      lr
        .section .text.thumb, "ax"
        .thumb
        .thumb_func
tfunc:  bl      afunc
        blx     afunc
        bl      tfunc2
        blx     tfunc2
        bl      start
        bx      lr
        .thumb_func
tfunc2: bx      lr
        .section .text.arm, "ax"
        .arm
        .type   afunc, %function
afunc:  bx      lr

=== addresses of Thumb functions in data and literal pools
        .syntax unified
        .text
        ldr     r0, =tfunc
        ldr     r1, =afunc
        bx      lr
        .type   afunc, %function
afunc:  bx      lr
        .thumb
        .thumb_func
tfunc:  bx      lr
        .data
        .word   tfunc, afunc, tfunc + 4

=== global Thumb functions called from the same section
        .syntax unified
        .global g
        .thumb
        .thumb_func
g:      bx      lr
        .arm
        bl      g
        blx     g
        .thumb
        blx     g
        bl      g
        bx      lr

=== a code section ending in Thumb is padded with Thumb no-ops
        .syntax unified
        .text
        .type   fa, %function
fa:     bx      lr
        .thumb
        .thumb_func
fb:     bx      lr
        .section .text.b, "ax"
        .arm
        .type   fc, %function
fc:     bl      fb
        bx      lr
